summary: Complete documentation map for Hoplight's user guidance, contributor references, accepted decisions, future contracts, and generated support material. Guide lists task pages for setup, importing, converting, editing, exporting, and lorebooks, plus platform pages for Agnai, Backyard, Chub, Lumiverse, Marinara, NovelAI, Pygmalion, RisuAI, RoleCall, and SillyTavern. Reference points builders to the reference-tree contract, as-built architecture, canonical entity schemas, format coverage, cross-cutting concepts, the Studio and Kit UI, generated component catalog, and platform-native field research; Chub is represented through its guide, coverage matrix, and adapter source rather than a dedicated reference page. Decisions and planning separates accepted ADRs, the required vision/architecture/conventions spine, the detailed source map, roadmap exit criteria, and the live-registry FORMAT-SUPPORT matrix. It also distinguishes generated field tables, figure data, and media assets from browsable prose pages, and warns that specifications describe planned or load-bearing contracts without proving every feature ships.

sections.title: Guide
sections.summary: Guide is the task-oriented user path. Getting started covers installation, first-run setup, the Dock, and the first imported file. Importing explains bringing files into the Library and interpreting receipts. Converting covers moving a card between platform formats. Editing follows a piece onto the Workbench and through explicit draft saving. Exporting covers both the character editor's send-out flow and staged batch output. Lorebooks teaches entries, keywords, triggers, and placement. The platform directory then supplies one source-platform page for Agnai, Backyard, Chub, Lumiverse, Marinara, NovelAI, Pygmalion, RisuAI, RoleCall, and SillyTavern.

sections.title: Reference
sections.summary: Reference is the contributor-facing statement of shipping behavior. Its root explains the tree contract and field tables; architecture maps the canonical model, escrow, adapters, entity kinds, registry, and CLI. Entity pages define character, lorebook, pack, persona, preset, and regex schemas. Format pages pair the coverage matrix with family-specific behavior, while concept pages cover embedded character books, persona and regex editors, regex execution, safe rendering, and tags. The UI page covers the visual Studio and Kit, components is generated from source, and platform-native-fields records verified native research. Chub has no dedicated reference page yet, so its current format truth remains in the matrix and adapter folder.

sections.title: Decisions and planning
sections.summary: Decisions and planning explains which documents carry authority. Accepted ADRs live under docs/decisions and must be read in order with explicit supersession honored. The required spine is 01-VISION for product intent, 02-ARCHITECTURE for canonical structure, and 03-CONVENTIONS for implementation rules; reference/architecture is the detailed current source map. ROADMAP holds milestones and release exit criteria. FORMAT-SUPPORT is generated from the live adapter registry with bun run matrix and records per-field format coverage. Detailed specs remain contracts for planned or load-bearing areas, not automatic shipping evidence. Generated field tables, figure data, and media screenshots support other pages and are not standalone navigation destinations.
